cues.line: Every hackathon team loses the last two hours to docs. This is campus-queue — and it had almost no README when we started.

Here is the repo: 9 files. The analyser read them all and pulled out 6 HTTP endpoints (GET /api/counters, GET /api/counters/:id, POST /api/counters/:id/join, POST /api/counters/:id/next, POST /api/counters/:id/done/:tokenId, POST /api/counters/:id/leave/:tokenId).
From those files alone it wrote the README — install, run, and the API table. Nothing in it comes from anywhere else.
Same facts, eight slides: problem, solution, demo, how it works, stack, next steps, team, ask.
